description: A shell script used for testing the 'git am' command with various options and scenarios, including interrupted applications, skipping patches, applying to specific directories, and handling rejections.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success if the commands within are successful.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the enclosed command to fail.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the fake timestamp used in tests to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
